description: Henrico, VA – Today, prosecutor Shannon Taylor launched a new TV ad in her campaign for Congress, "Doing What's Right," spotlighting how she took on then-powerful Democratic lawmaker Joe Morrissey after he was accused of having sex with an underage girl and possessing child pornography – because for Shannon, doing what’s right matters more than political party.
